instruction.text: Vervollständige das Klassengespräch, indem du die passenden Sehenswürdigkeiten Londons auswählst.

atoms.b: Good morning class. In three months we will go on a trip to London. Which ((++sights towns people)) do you want to visit there?
atoms.sound: Good morning class. In three months we will go on a trip to London. Which sights do you want to visit there?

atoms.b: I want to go to ((++Covent_Garden Madame_Tussauds Tower_Bridge)). There we can buy delicious food and listen to buskers.
atoms.sound: I want to go to covent garden. There we can buy delicious food and listen to buskers.

hint.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>buskers</voice> bedeutet auf Deutsch Straßenkünstler

atoms.b: Me too. We can also buy souvenirs there for our friends and family.
atoms.sound: Me too. We can also buy souvenirs there for our friends and family.

atoms.b: I want to go to the ((++London_Eye Buckingham_Palace Tate_Modern)). We can have an amazing view of London up there.
atoms.sound: I want to go to the London Eye. We can have an amazing view of London up there.

atoms.b: I don't want to go to the London Eye, because I'm afraid of heights.
atoms.sound: I don't want to go to the London Eye, because I'm afraid of heights.

atoms.b: What about ((++Tate_Modern Big_Ben Trafalgar_Square))? We can look at some cool art. And the entry is free.
atoms.sound: What about Tate Modern? We can look at some cool art. And the entry is free.

atoms.b: Let's go to the ((Tower_Brige Sherlock_Holmes_Museum ++Emirates_Stadium)) too. I am a huge fan of Arsenal FC. We can watch a football game there.
atoms.sound: Let's go to the Emirates Stadium too. I am a huge fan of Arsenal FC. We can watch a football game there.

atoms.b: I don't want to go to the Emirates Stadium, because I don't like football.
atoms.sound: I don't want to go to the Emirates Stadium, because I don't like football.

atoms.b: Let's go to ((++Buckingham_Palace Science_Museum Film_Museum)) instead. Maybe we will see the King.
atoms.sound: Let's go to Buckingham Palace instead. Maybe we will see the King.

atoms.b: Okay! On our trip to London we will ((++visit fly sights)) Covent Garden, Tate Modern and Buckingham Palace.
atoms.sound: Okay! On our trip to London we will visit Covent Garden, Tate Modern and Buckingham Palace.
